name: GCSE Combined Science: Trilogy (AQA 8464) — Foundation and Higher tier

selected_options.tiers_built: Both Foundation and Higher, consistent with how Mathematics was built -- each stage teaches the shared core with Higher-tier extension content marked separately

material_vintage: AQA GCSE Combined Science: Trilogy (8464) specification (first teaching 2016, current and live). The subject-content section headings and codes for Biology 4.1-4.7, Chemistry 5.1-5.10 and Physics 6.1-6.8 were itemised on 2026-09-19 from AQA's own Trilogy subject-content pages; the 21 required practicals, Working scientifically (section 3) and the Mathematical requirements (section 7) follow the AQA Trilogy pages and the shared separate-science definitions. Lesson text for content shared with the separate sciences is adapted from that course and limited to the Trilogy statements; HT flags follow the fetched pages and should be re-verified against the live specification. Trilogy Biology 4.7 and Physics 6.8 (a narrative section with no numbered statements) are flagged for re-verification. Stage test scenarios are original questions written in the style of AQA papers, not real past-paper items.
level_source: RQF Level 2 (GCSE, full grade range 1-9 / Foundation+Higher tiers covered), per Ofqual's Register of Regulated Qualifications listing for this specification
